# Muhammad Novel - Penetration Tester & Security Analyst

**Location:** Malang / Pasuruan, East Java, Indonesia  
**Status:** Available for Collaboration & Professional Discussions  
**Website:** https://novelwardah.com/

---

## ABOUT ME

I am an **Informatics Engineering** graduate from **Universitas Muhammadiyah Malang** with a deep interest in **Cyber Security**, **Cloud Computing**, and software development. I have work experience in the cybersecurity field and have completed various professional certifications, including **CND** and **ECIH** from EC-Council, as well as **CCNA CyberOps** from Cisco.

I currently serve as a **Security Engineer** at **RSUD dr. R. Soedarsono Kota Pasuruan**, where I am responsible for hospital information system security, server infrastructure management, and cybersecurity incident response.

Previously, I served as **Head of Research and Development** at LSO Kaliber (2021–2024), where I developed web applications, created cyber security educational modules, and mentored members. I also have experience as a **Penetration Tester** and **Security Analyst** at CSIRT UMM, focusing on web security testing, network security, and digital forensics.

---

## WORK EXPERIENCE

### Security Engineer
**RSUD dr. R. Soedarsono** · Feb 2025 - Present

- Managing and maintaining hospital information system (SIMRS) security and server infrastructure to ensure 24/7 service availability.
- Conducting comprehensive security management, including penetration testing, security monitoring (SIEM/IDS/IPS), and rapid response to cyber incidents.
- Implementing cybersecurity policies to protect patient data from internal and external threats.
- Collaborating with medical teams and management to optimize technology utilization and ensure compliance with information security standards.

### Computer Security Incident Response Team - Internship
**CSIRT UMM** · Nov 2021 - Jan 2024

- Conducted comprehensive penetration testing to identify and remediate vulnerabilities in web applications, server configurations, and development frameworks.
- Implemented and maintained network security protocols, including IDS/IPS (Snort, Suricata) for proactive threat detection and mitigation.
- Designed and deployed honeypots to detect and analyze malicious activities.
- Conducted forensic investigations on systems that experienced security breaches, collecting and analyzing digital evidence.
- Produced clear and structured security reports to communicate findings, recommendations, and remediation steps.

### Head of Research and Development
**LSO Kaliber** · 2021 - 2024

- Developed the Kaliber web application as an internal organizational platform.
- Created and designed cyber security educational modules for members.
- Served as a mentor for Kaliber members in cyber security and technology development.
